title.narrative: Reduction of the incidence and mortality due to tuberculosis in the Dominican Republic, focusing interventions on key populations and risk groups to end the epidemic in the country - Dominican Republic (01-Jan-2019-30-Jun-2022)

description.narrative: Dominican Republic, Tuberculosis, Ministry of Public Health and Social Assistance of the Dominican Republic (MSP)This program has the following goals: Maintain and extend achievements in tuberculosis (TB) control during the transition phase with national resources.. The objectives of this program are: Implement innovative strategies to make public expenditure on the national response to TB more efficient.. Mobilize resources from different public sources to ensure a full transition to funding of the national response to TB from national resources.

title.narrative: Impact indicators targets and results for DOM-T-MSPASP02
RR-TB and/or MDR-TB prevalence among new TB patients: Proportion of new TB patients with RR-TB and/or MDR-TB
Coverage / Output indicators targets and results for DOM-T-MSPASP02
Number of cases with RR-TB and/or MDR-TB that began second-line treatment
Number of TB cases with RR-TB and/or MDR-TB notified
Number of notified cases of all forms of TB (i.e. bacteriologically confirmed + clinically diagnosed), new and relapse cases
Percentage of HIV-positive new and relapse TB patients on ART during TB treatment

Treatment success rate- all forms: Percentage of TB cases, all forms, bacteriologically confirmed plus clinically diagnosed, successfully treated (cured plus treatment completed) among all TB cases registered for treatment during a specified period, new and relapse cases
Outcome indicators targets and results for DOM-T-MSPASP02
Treatment success rate of RR-TB and/or MDR-TB: Percentage of patients with RR and/or MDR-TB successfully treated
